thread:
anya: Quick sync from today's UX sprint: proposal to collapse the p95 header and move the sampling control to a contextual flyout off the time scrubber. Thoughts?
sam: flyout keeps scrubber clean but adds one click to change sample. worried about discoverability. :thinking_face:
matt: prototyped a hover-trigger flyout + persistent pin in header for power users. figma: https://figma.com/s/p95-flyout (notes in comments)
anya: hover trigger ok for desktops, but we need keyboard & mobile. maybe allow long-press on scrubber for mobile to open flyout.
leo: accessibility: flyout must be reachable via keyboard (tab to scrubber, enter to open), and the controls inside need 44px min target. focus trap while flyout open.
aria: SR note: the flyout should announce its role and current sampling value. use `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`. announce updates with aria-live when value changes.
katie: copy: inside flyout, label as "Trace sampling"; subtitle: "Show a subset of traces to reduce visual noise". presets: Tiny (0.5%), Low (5%), Full (100%).
sam: can we show a tiny sparkline in the flyout for immediate context? helps users see how sampling impacts curve.
matt: yes, we can embed a 1-row sparkline and a small counts row. implementation: `MiniSparkline` + `SamplerSlider` components. I'll add tokens for spacing.
leo: keyboard interactions: left/right = 1% step, shift+arrow = 10%, home/end to extremes, enter to apply preset. SR should announce only on apply to reduce chatter.
aria: for screen readers avoid exposing each heatmap bucket individually. provide a "Bucket summary" control that expands into a listbox when requested. default to density-only presentation.
anya: mobile: long-press to open flyout, show presets as large tappable chips, and keep numeric overlay while dragging.
katie: microcopy tweak: change "Show a subset of traces" -> "Display a representative subset of traces" (slightly clearer).
sam: also request a small confirmation microcopy when switching presets: "Sampling set to Low (5%)" that fades after 2s.
matt: dev handoff checklist: component variants `sampler--flyout`, focus tokens, 44px hit area, aria-live id `sampler-announcer`, preset labels, sparks + counts, mobile long-press gesture notes. I'll drop updated figma and tokens.
anya: next steps: matt to update figma + handoff; leo/aria to run a keyboard & SR smoke test on the prototype; katie to finalize microcopy; sam to run a quick 3-person usability check.
ux-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/sampler-flyout-preview (expires in 48h)
anya: great — thanks all. we'll reconvene after the mini-lab. :thumbsup:
